about.body: The B37 is BMW's modular 1.5-litre three-cylinder turbo-diesel engine, introduced in 2014 as part of the same modular engine family as the B47 and B57. It's one of BMW's more compact diesel offerings, used primarily in the smaller models in the range — the 1 Series, X1 and X2. The B37 shares its architecture with the petrol B38 but runs a diesel-specific bottom end and fuel system. For owners researching economy-focused BMW diesel applications, this is the entry-level unit you'll find in 116d and smaller SUVs.

byModel.body: Across the 1 Series, the B37 was used in the 116d (F20/F21, 2015–2019) — the diesel entry point to the hatchback range. In the X1, it powered the sDrive16d and xDrive18d (F48, 2015–2022), and in the X2, the sDrive16d and xDrive18d (F39, 2017–2023). These three applications represent the full B37 spread in the UK market.

compatibility.body: Because the B37 is a smaller-capacity, more compact design than the larger diesel units, compatibility between different models isn't a simple drop-in match. A B37 from a 1 Series won't necessarily fit an X1 or X2 without the correct ancillaries and mounting. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle by registration/VIN.
